title: pandanus balansae
intro: Pandanus balansae, commonly known as the Pandan plant, is a tropical plant native to the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia. It is valued for its fragrant leaves, which are used in various culinary and traditional medicine applications. The health benefits of Pandan plant include its potential to help manage diabetes due to its antidiabetic properties, and it may also help reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Pandan balansae include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
